beats.say: OpenAI has released two results about the Navier Stokes equations. Both use a deliberately chosen force.
beats.cap: OpenAI has released two results about the Navier–Stokes equations. Both use a deliberately chosen force.

beats.say: In the first, the force stays smooth while the fluid's peak speed becomes unbounded in finite time.
beats.cap: In the first, the force stays smooth while the fluid’s peak speed becomes unbounded in finite time.

beats.say: The fast region contracts enough for the total energy to stay bounded.
beats.cap: The fast region contracts enough for the total energy to stay bounded.

beats.say: The force supplies energy. With no force and a fluid initially at rest, the fluid stays at rest.
beats.cap: The force supplies energy. With no force and a fluid initially at rest, the fluid stays at rest.

beats.say: For the second result, imagine a program that starts at zero, adds one twice, and stops. Assign each state a position. Moving a particle between those positions represents running the program.
beats.cap: For the second result, imagine a program that starts at zero, adds one twice, and stops. Assign each state a position. Moving a particle between those positions represents running the program.

beats.say: The papers build a smooth force that makes a particle follow an arbitrary machine's instructions. Entering a marked box means the machine has stopped. Deciding whether it ever enters would decide whether the program halts. No algorithm can decide that for every program.
beats.cap: The papers build a smooth force that makes a particle follow an arbitrary machine’s instructions. Entering a marked box means the machine has stopped. Deciding whether it ever enters would decide whether the program halts. No algorithm can decide that for every program.

beats.say: For general smooth initial data, whether a three-dimensional flow stays smooth without any force is still open.
beats.cap: For general smooth initial data, whether a three-dimensional flow stays smooth without any force is still open.
